page.content:
Living Horus and dead Osiris — the office that holds maat.

How Pharaoh connects

  • Character: Horus — The living pharaoh is the earthly Horus.
  • Character: Osiris — The dead pharaoh becomes Osiris in the tomb.
  • Concept: Maat — The pharaoh's office is to maintain maat on the Nile.

What is Pharaoh?

Pharaoh is the dual king of Upper and Lower Egypt, son of Ra, who builds temples, leads ritual, and must keep maat. The office, not only the person, is the mythic hinge.

Key threads lead to Horus, Osiris and Maat.
